notes: An audit pass on the report jobs in Repair. The tools behind them do not always fail when they fail: powercfg can report success while writing nothing, which meant PowerX could open the previous run's report as if it were new. A report is now only offered if it was actually written by the run you just started, and PowerX says so plainly when nothing was written. Also fixes a latent memory bug in process enumeration, and a case where the Recommended repair button could silently do nothing.
